Please re-write the following passage to sound more professional. This is for an annual job performance review. In this passage focus on judgment with an emphasis on these core attributes: 1. Displays willingness to make decisions, 2. Makes timely decisions, 3. Includes appropriate people in decision-making process, 4. Supports and explains reasoning for decisions, 5. Exhibits sound and accurate judgment. Feel free to embellish these attributes.

I have used my judgment to make informed decisions about a variety of things, whether it's weeding materials, ordering books, or coordinating programs. I am always willing to consult both my colleagues and resources to assess and analyze the best ways to move forward in any given situation. I also use my judgment when handling patron interactions and inquiries. In using my knowledge and experience, I'm able to assess the level of granularity with which I respond to different reference needs. When engaging with difficult patrons I use my judgment to assess and deescalate the situation.
